title: Sprint 4 Reflection: What I Learned and How I Know
description: Use AI follow-up questions to separate what you checked from what you were told.

questions.prompt: Draft your Sprint 4 reflection. Name one thing you can now do or decide that you could not at the start of the sprint, what AI explained well and whether you ever checked it, what came back different from what you expected, and what you are still not ready to claim.
questions.placeholder: Use your gap list, your learning path, your verification log, and your revised Goal Plan. Separate what you checked from what you were told.
questions.aiContext: This is the Sprint 4 reflection for Reframing Problems with AI. The participant is separating what they verified from what AI explained to them. Ask follow-up questions that catch a topic described in place of a capability, confidence that rests on an unchecked explanation, and claims marked confirmed without an independent source. Push them to name something they half-know and would be tempted to state confidently. Do not rewrite the reflection for them.
questions.discussionPrompt: Use these questions to revise your reflection. Your refined version should make clear which claims rest on evidence and which rest on a good explanation.
questions.summaryPlaceholder: Write the final version you want to submit. Include the capability you gained, what you checked versus what you were told, what came back unexpected, and what you are still not ready to claim.
